==Biography==
Džiugas is from Vilnius, Lithuania.

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Mazzerin''' comes from the name of an elven NPC in the game ''Arcanum''.
* Is a huge metal fan.
* Known for his {{ci|Orianna}}.
* Is a well known mapper in the popular rhythm game osu! known for making some of the game's hardest maps.
